manualValidationGuidance: Browser semantics and deterministic rules support the technical candidate only. For prohibited ARIA attributes, separately establish user-interface-component applicability, whether the attribute carries required component information, and whether that information is programmatically unavailable; the axe result alone is insufficient because the related ACT rule is stricter than WCAG 4.1.2. Validate complex custom-control behavior and actual assistive-technology interaction separately when those claims are needed.
